A formatted note is a machine-readable version of a handwritten note: each page is transcribed into Markdown (LaTeX for formulas, Mermaid for flowcharts). It is readable by people and software, and the whole folder can be copied into Obsidian.

How it is made: bookshelf note card → More → Convert to formatted notes. Each page is sent to your configured vision model, transcribed, and merged in page order. The handwritten original is unchanged.
How it relates to AI: the library is not sent to a model by default. After selecting content, choose a specific formatted note in the AI card to preview and freeze a readable copy for this request.
Storage and privacy: files are saved in the app’s private storage. Content is sent to a model endpoint only for digitization or when you ask a question.
